html: The KEAP1-NRF2 core in two flow directions, kept for comparison. Both are laid out by a person's story: the main column from the NFE2L2 gene to NRF2's degradation, the ligase beside it with its three modifications beyond, the escape to the nucleus on the near side. The left-to-right one here is the top-to-bottom drawing turned. The map itself (group ExposomeMap) is drawn left to right for that direction, the cytosol on the left and the nucleus on the right. No overlaps, one crossing in each trial.
